title: Bondi Beach Volleyball Community Day
venue: Bondi Beach, Ramp 2 (near the skate park)
imageAlt: Players leaping at the net against a golden sunset
excerpt: A free community event for all ages and abilities, with Olympic medallist Mariafe Artacho del Solar and Australian National Team player Oliver Merritt. Proudly supported by Budgy Smuggler.
description: Proudly supported by Budgy Smuggler. Join us at Bondi Beach, Ramp 2 (near the skate park) on Saturday 12 December 2026, from 10am till late — a free community event for all ages and abilities!
Special guest athletes: Olympic, World and Commonwealth Games medallist Mariafe Artacho del Solar and Australian National Team player Oliver Merritt!

Aussie Athlete Fundraising BBQ | 12 noon — near Bondi Pavilion and the children’s playground. Buy lunch at our BBQ and help fundraise for beach volleyball athlete Brooke Ronan. Meet and greet with Olympians and VIP guests.
Everyone welcome | Family friendly | Free entry. Follow Beach Volleyball TV on Instagram and join our Instagram group for the full schedule and event updates.
format: Special guests: Mariafe Artacho del Solar & Oliver Merritt
includes: Beach volleyball activities for toddlers and kids
Coaching sessions for beginners, intermediate and advanced players
Men’s and women’s exhibition matches featuring Olympians and Australian athletes
Aussie Athlete Fundraising BBQ at 12 noon — supporting Brooke Ronan
